original.question: Sebaka sa Billie wa kamore ya boroko ya sekwere ke 360 dikhatara tše dikgolo. Fa boleele bja kamore bo le 3 diyard(s), perimeter ya kamore ka diiti ke bokae?
original.answer:
Boleele bja kamore bo 3 diyard(s) * (3 diiti / 1 diyard(s)) = <<3*(3/1)=9>>9 diiti.
Bophara bja kamore bo 360 dikhatara tše dikgolo / 9 diiti = <<360/9=40>>40 diiti.
Perimeter ya kamore ke 2(40+9) = 98 diiti
